_comment: Middleware config — read by `node dist/core/main.js` (default path ~/.config/wcppm/config.json). The WeChat server connection lives HERE now, not in openclaw.json.
_single_instance_comment: SINGLE INSTANCE: set the WeChat fields at the top level (host/port/authcode/wsUrl/wxid). `account` labels it (default "default").
_instances_comment: MULTI INSTANCE: instead of the flat host/port/authcode above, provide an `instances` array — each entry is one WeChat account with its own account label, host, port (HTTP API), wsUrl (WS push), and wxid (routes shared-webhook pushes). `account` must be UNIQUE per entry. When `instances` is present it supersedes the flat fields. Example: "instances": [ {"account":"acctA","host":"100.64.0.8","port":8062,"authcode":"AC_A","wsUrl":"ws://100.64.0.8:8089/ws/sync","wxid":"wxid_a"}, {"account":"acctB","host":"100.64.0.8","port":8072,"authcode":"AC_B","wsUrl":"ws://100.64.0.8:8090/ws/sync","wxid":"wxid_b"} ]
_webhook_comment: ONE shared webhook listener for ALL instances. WCPPM pushes are routed to the owning instance by the envelope's Wxid (point each WCPPM instance's webhook at this one URL; use the same secret across instances).
_imageRetry_comment: Randomized retry for the CDN image download (the object isn't always ready the instant the push arrives). Total attempts are random in [minAttempts,maxAttempts]; each backoff = baseDelayMs × (1 ± jitterPct). Leave randomSeed null in production (unpredictable cadence); set a number/string ONLY to reproduce a run while debugging.
_bridge_comment: Downstream interface the OpenClaw adapter (and other bots) connect to.
_mediaDir_comment: Where inbound images are downloaded for the agent. For the OpenClaw adapter this MUST be under an allowed media root (a subdir of /tmp/openclaw or <stateDir>/media) or the agent's image tool rejects the path. Default: <tmp>/wcppm-lob-media.
_heartbeat_comment: Heartbeat conductor (default-off). Enable to keep the WCPPM longlink alive via periodic /api/Login/HeartBeat calls.
_outboundPacer_comment: Outbound humanizing pacer (default-OFF = transparent pass-through, instant sends). Enable to make reply timing resemble a real Mac client and to cap outbound rate (the 2026-04-12 ban vector). Sits at the /send choke point, per-account; global default + per-instance override like heartbeat. WHEN ENABLED the /send contract changes to ack-on-enqueue (ok=true means 'queued', not 'delivered'); the in-memory queue means a restart in the delay window drops not-yet-sent replies (inbound is still persisted). firstReply*=A read/compose delay before the first send into an idle conversation (length-scaled+jittered, capped at a few seconds); minGapMs+ceiling*=E pacing/burst cap (per-conversation min-gap + per-account sliding-window ceiling; maxQueueDepth drops+warns as the hard backstop); quietHours=D nightly slow-down. NOTE: the adapter-side knobs (B/C) live in openclaw.json, NOT here — see below.
_adapter_humanization_comment: The other two humanization knobs live on the OPENCLAW side (openclaw.json), not in this middleware config, because they ride OpenClaw's reply pipeline: (C) inter-block reply pacing → agents.defaults.humanDelay { mode:'natural', minMs, maxMs }; (B) inbound coalescing of a rapid same-sender burst into one agent dispatch → messages.inbound.debounceMs (or messages.inbound.byChannel.wechatpadpro). Both default to no-op.
